# Adjustment notes
- All legacy marks have been made out of components to reduce the repetition in hinting - All accent marks have been slightly modified in height and position to align better. This is true in ALL optical sizes
- Numbers (0123456789) (+tf variants) jump at optical size 14 to avoid a form morphing in interim steps (Angled to straight forms), which can look strange.
– symbols – fixed minor spacing errors (tabular forms in the period.tf comma.tf colon.tf)
– tcommaaccent.alt had an incorrect form – tcedilla.alt was missing. Added in! – jdotless.alt jcircumflex.alt added – t_f t_f.alt – changed the f terminal to be inline with all of the other f components
# Cyrillic notes
Differences between Text and Sans
/H Text is 11 units narrower in Regular /H Text is 4 units narrower in Bold
/C Text is 49 narrower in Regular /C Text is in Bold
/P W -25 Regular /P W -32 Bold
/n Text is 14 units narrower in Regular /n Text is 3 units narrower in Bold
/n Text is 42 units taller in Regular /n Text is 42 units taller in Bold
